say:1:1441103001:1.text: Ore Festival, Hammer Day, Furnace Celebration, Barrel Bonanza...
say:1:1441103001:1.source_cn: 巨矿祭，锤击节，锻炉庆典，酒桶狂欢日……

say:2:1441103002:0.text: Hammie, what are you mumbling about?

say:3:1441103003:1.source_cn: 是我来深岩村之前做的笔记啦。

say:4:1441103004:1.text: Before coming here, I did some research on dwarven customs. It's said that they enjoy throwing feasts, big and small.
say:4:1441103004:1.source_cn: 来之前我特意查阅了矮人的习俗，据说矮人们喜欢举办大大小...

say:5:1441103005:0.text: There are grand feasts for traditional festivals and smaller family gatherings...
say:5:1441103005:0.source_cn: 有为了庆祝传统节日而举办的盛大宴会，也有小型的家族宴会...

choice_prompt:6:1441103005.text: There are grand feasts for traditional festivals and smaller family gatherings...
choice_prompt:6:1441103005.source_cn: 有为了庆祝传统节日而举办的盛大宴会，也有小型的家族宴会和庆典……

say:7:1441103006:1.text: They sing and dance, recite hymns, and share tales of legendary weapons. Occasionally, they also hold weapon contests!
say:7:1441103006:1.source_cn: 宴会上矮人们会载歌载舞，朗诵神明颂歌和武器传说，有时还...

say:8:1441103007:1.text: But we didn't experience any of that at the chief's feast!
say:8:1441103007:1.source_cn: 我们在村长安排的宴会上一个都没见到嘛！

choice_prompt:9:1441103007.text: But we didn't experience any of that at the chief's feast!
choice_prompt:9:1441103007.source_cn: 我们在村长安排的宴会上一个都没见到嘛！

say:10:1441103008:1.text: Be that as it may, the roast turkey at the feast really won Chippy's heart! It was stuffed with apple slices and nuts, and the drumsticks were huge and flavorful...
say:10:1441103008:1.source_cn: 不过满满觉得，宴会上的烤火鸡还是蛮好吃的！火鸡肚子里塞...

say:12:1441103010:1.text: My mouth is watering just thinking about those drumsticks!
say:12:1441103010:1.source_cn: 不能想了……想着又想再吃一只鸡腿了！

choice:9:0:1.text: He only did the bare minimum.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 这就是所谓的“公务招待”
choice:9:0:1.male: He only did the bare minimum.
choice:9:0:1.female: He only did the bare minimum.

choice:9:1:2.text: He didn't see us as friends.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 这就是所谓的“商业宴请”
choice:9:1:2.male: He didn't see us as friends.
choice:9:1:2.female: He didn't see us as friends.

choice:6:0:1.text: What do they do at the feasts?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 矮人们会在宴会上做什么？
choice:6:0:1.male: What do they do at the feasts?
choice:6:0:1.female: What do they do at the feasts?
